Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 15
Reason for Mistake: The Planner fixated on resolving a minor discrepancy in Maurice Tourneur’s birth year (1873 vs. 1876) instead of synthesizing the already sufficient data to answer the question. Regardless of the exact year, both dates are earlier than Fern Andra’s 1893, so the Planner should have concluded that Fun in the Barracks has the director born earlier. This overemphasis on reconciling conflicting sources led to unnecessary delay and failure to provide the final comparison.
